I will not spare you what I see.

Mode: Exposure / drift: Toward

Level 1: The Reading Eye

When you focus on a creature, object, location, or ongoing situation for [TBD:balance — 1 minute], you may spend 1 Lens Charge to perceive one concealed truth: a lie recently told, a hidden motive, a secret identity, a disguise, a false document, an active Stealth. The GM reveals one such truth at their discretion if more than one applies.

Level 5: The Unconcealed Word

When a creature in your presence lies aloud, you may spend 1 Lens Charge as a reaction to perceive the truth they are lying about. You do not automatically speak the truth; you simply know it. Other creatures do not perceive your use of this ability.

Level 9: The Forced Clarity

Once per scene, you may spend 3 Lens Charges to create a Zone of Clarity — a 30-foot radius around you for [TBD:balance — 1 minute] in which no creature may successfully lie, conceal, or obscure their intentions through speech. Mental concealment (occluded thoughts, non-verbal Stealth) is unaffected.

Level 13: The Exposure

Once per scene, you may spend 5 Lens Charges to publicly reveal one concealed truth about a creature, faction, or institution present in the scene. The revelation is spoken aloud, cannot be unspoken, and carries mechanical consequences: the target suffers [TBD:balance — Morale penalty, Political Drift shift, social cascade] appropriate to the revelation's severity.

Level 17: The Book Written In The Open (Capstone)

Once per campaign, you may begin a Public Record — a formal, ongoing, written account of truths you have perceived over the campaign. The Record is physical (a book, a scroll, a chiseled inscription) and is metaphysically protected — it cannot be destroyed, suppressed, or privately revised. Each session from now on, you may add one truth to the Record. The Record becomes a setting fixture: factions consult it, enemies avoid being recorded in it, historians cite it.

⟁ Per-Use Abilities — Refraction of Truth
